## This work (Р-215)

The official Russian edition «Погасший маяк» (`lightless-beacon-ru`, 44 pages, text layer; printed/physical relation — find and report). Its pre-generated investigators and two creatures are already in `kb/books/lightless-beacon-ru/` — link them, never duplicate; edits of them go through your proposals file. The English original `[EN 7e] The Lightless Beacon` lies in the same library folder (register it as `lightless-beacon-en` with `python -B pipeline/source/pages.py register …` if you need it to check numbers). Russian text — as printed in the official edition (no `translated`). Handouts — the official Russian handouts `…\Погасший маяк (The Lightless Beacon)\Раздатка\[RU 7e] раздатка.pdf`. Run tools as `python -B …`.

- Records — book-scoped `lightless-beacon-ru/<kind>/<slug>` in `kb/books/lightless-beacon-ru/<kinds>/`, slugs with the prefix `beacon-`: scenario `lightless-beacon` (summary, keeper_info, hook, advice, steps with refs, conclusion with Sanity rewards, tables), every scene retold for play (`arc`), items, handouts, organizations, characters (NPCs with statblocks as printed, Р-25), creatures (link the existing two; known Mythos creatures → `instance_of` the shared `coc:creature:*`), places. The lighthouse island off the Massachusetts coast (1926): the nearest town as a shared city (`coc:location:<slug>`, create if missing, Р-190; if the book names none — an «окрестности» area under the nearest shared city mentioned, e.g. Kingsport/Innsmouth/Arkham if the text says so), the island and the lighthouse with its rooms as book places (Р-209). Maps — `map` with the image (`app/maps/beacon-<slug>.jpg`) and spots on every printed number/label (Р-206; check each by eye on a crop); every key number gets a place record. List captions — neutral, no spoilers (Р-209).
- `axes.era` ["1920s"], `ruleset` "core". Book misprints — `errata` as printed (Р-35).
- Coverage: `checks/20261112-lightless-beacon/beacon.md` — every heading → record(s), «не взято» with the reason.
